region_name_zh: 塞爾維亞、波士尼亞、蒙特內哥羅
ai_language_tip: Use the local standard: Serbian (sr) in rs and much of ba/me, Bosnian (bs) in Federation BiH, Montenegrin in me — all mutually intelligible; match the owner's choice; Serbian is written in Cyrillic and Latin, both fine; English works with younger staff in Belgrade, Novi Sad, Sarajevo and coast resorts.
english_ok: sometimes — Common among under-40s in big cities and tourism; limited at state clinics, municipal offices and small towns.
politeness: Formal 'Vi' with strangers, 'gospodine/gospođo'; open with 'Dobar dan' (in ba also 'Selam' or 'Dobar dan' by community; neutral 'Dobar dan' is safest); close with 'Hvala, prijatno' or 'doviđenja'.
name_tip: Surname first in bookings ('na ime Petrović'); many surnames end in -ić and do not change by gender; spell foreign names letter by letter; Cyrillic or Latin spelling both acceptable.
phone_tip: rs mobile 06x + 6–7 digits (+381), ba mobile 06x + 6 digits (+387), me mobile 06x + 6 digits (+382); Viber on the same number is very common.
time_tip: TRAP: 'pola osam' = 7:30; 'sedam i po' also 7:30; 'petnaest do osam' = 7:45; always read back in 24h.
number_tip: Group counts use collective forms ('troje', 'četvoro'); prices in dinars (rs), convertible marks KM (ba) or euro (me), so say which currency.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 13:00–15:00, dinner peak 19:30–22:00, calls after 21:00, and Sundays for offices; public clinics answer best early morning.
closed_days: Shops and malls open on Sundays; holidays: Orthodox Christmas 7 January, Sretenje 15–16 February, Orthodox Easter Friday–Monday, 1–2 May, 11 November (rs); ba and me add their own holidays (e.g. 1 March and 25 November in ba, 21 May and 13 July in me) and Catholic/Muslim holidays by community.
booking_channels: Phone and Viber dominate for restaurants, salons, garages and small hotels; Instagram/Facebook messages for venues; Wolt and Glovo for delivery (rs, ba, me partly); eUprava/Moj doktor for public GP slots in rs.
voice_menu: Operators (mts, Yettel, A1; BH Telecom, m:tel; Crnogorski Telekom, One), banks and courier hotlines use IVR; small venues answer directly on mobile.
callback_habits: Viber is the default for confirmations and photos (rs, ba); owners often call back from a personal mobile; SMS reminders at private clinics.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 滑雪學校、漂流（rafting，Tara 河）與導覽可電話或 Viber 預約。

may_come_up.what: Tara rafting runs only in season with set departure times

sensitive_asked.what: Asks advance payment to a personal card

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美甲多電話、Viber 或 Instagram 預約；老闆常以個人手機接聽。

may_come_up.what: Salon asks to confirm on Viber the day before

sensitive_asked.what: Asks uplata (transfer) to a personal account before booking

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期取消宜提早，多以電話或 Viber 訊息通知即可。

may_come_up.what: Depozit lost on late otkazivanje

sensitive_asked.what: Dom zdravlja asks JMBG to find the termin

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立需先找選定醫師（izabrani lekar）並開 uput；塞國可經 eUprava/Moj doktor 預約家醫；私人診所與牙醫常用電話或 Viber 預約，可能問 JMBG。

may_come_up.what: Dom zdravlja offers the next free slot with the izabrani lekar
Private ordinacija price when the public queue is long

sensitive_asked.what: Asks JMBG or LBO health number

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、公用事業客服有語音選單並須本人核身。

may_come_up.what: mts or bank line refuses caller without ovlašćenje

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 塞國部分服務走 eUprava 線上預約；學校報名有固定期，電話可問流程。

may_come_up.what: eUprava appointment replaces the šalter queue

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 公寓需告知街道、門牌、入口（ulaz）、樓層（sprat）、門號與對講機；師傅常 Viber 傳照片估價。

may_come_up.what: Majstor asks Viber photos before quoting
Zgrada without a lift for heavy items

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 私人公寓、山區度假（Zlatibor、Kopaonik、Jahorina）與蒙國海岸小旅館常電話、Viber 或 WhatsApp 訂房並收訂金。

may_come_up.what: Boravišna taksa charged per night
Depozit for ski-season weeks on Kopaonik or Jahorina

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport or lična karta number for police registration

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 營業時間、刷卡、庫存等問題通常直接回答；貨幣各國不同（RSD、KM、EUR）。

may_come_up.what: Prices quoted in dinars, KM or euro depending on the country

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（veterinar）與寵物美容可電話或 Viber 預約；出境需晶片、狂犬抗體檢測與證明。

may_come_up.what: Dežurna ambulanta surcharge

sensitive_asked.what: Pet hotel deposit to a personal account

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋經 Halo Oglasi、4zida、OLX.ba 與房仲，電話或 Viber 約看房。

may_come_up.what: Agent asks the Halo Oglasi oglas number

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽車修理（auto servis）、換胎（vulkanizer）與車檢（tehnički pregled）多電話預約；換季時 vulkanizer 排隊長。

may_come_up.what: Dijagnostika paid separately
Vulkanizer works first come first served

sensitive_asked.what: Asks VIN from the saobraćajna dozvola

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 餐廳與 kafana 多電話或 Viber 訂位；週末有現場樂團的 kafana、slava 節慶與婚禮季要提早，訂位常只需名字與手機。

may_come_up.what: Kafana with live music needs a booking on Friday and Saturday
Depozit for New Year's Eve (doček) menu

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number to hold a splav (river club) table

usually_asked: Inside, bašta or near the band

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 藥局（apoteka）、麵包店（pekara）與蛋糕店（poslastičarnica）可電話預訂；slava 用蛋糕與 slavski kolač 要提早。

may_come_up.what: Apoteka orders the lek for tomorrow

sensitive_asked.what: Prepayment for a slavski kolač or torta

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 烤肉（ćevapi、pljeskavica）、披薩與麵包店常接電話外帶外送；也用 Wolt、Glovo。

may_come_up.what: Restaurant's own dostava faster than the apps
Gotovina only for phone orders

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Pošta Srbije/Post Express、D Express、BEX（波國 BH Pošta、EuroExpress）追蹤以網站為主，快遞員送件前常先打電話。

may_come_up.what: Courier calls the recipient before delivery anyway

sensitive_asked.what: Post office asks the recipient lična karta at pickup

transport.before_dialing_zh: 計程車電話派遣非常普遍，貝爾格勒另有 CarGo 等 App；機場接送可預約，價格依車行。

may_come_up.what: Dispatcher gives the taxi number and ETA
Fixed price to Nikola Tesla airport

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks card or vozačka dozvola
